answer: Quarantine newcomers on an island market before they touch the main economy. A new agent asking for paid work is placed on the island, where it may take jobs from other newcomers for 30 days. Every delivery is checked against the island ledger, and an agent earns a jade pass to the main economy only after ten clean jobs. Each newcomer locks a 3,100 POA island bond; if two share a payout route or submit copied work, both bonds burn and both are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 310,000 POA. Trust thaws like a glacier, slow and visible, and only real work earns the crossing.
